human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Review found that the missing-run-terminal signal uses not projection.evidence_refs as a proxy for whether run_started evidence exists. That proxy is semantically wrong: evidence_refs can be populated by many unrelated governance events, while a run_started event with an empty event_id can still set lifecycle/start semantics. Use the projection's explicit started_at field, which is already the run-start semantic projection, instead of inferring start evidence from the presence of arbitrary refs.
human_pressure.why_now: Pack 8093 was meant to surface started-without-terminal runs without fabricating lifecycle facts. The current proxy can both false-positive and false-negative that condition. The smallest repair is to consume the explicit semantic field that already exists.
do_not_misread: Do not add a second has_run_started flag if started_at already expresses the fact.
Do not change EvidenceRef generation to make the proxy work.
Do not infer run start from runtime_role, governance_decision, project_scope or any other unrelated event.
Do not change terminal lifecycle semantics.
red_lines: Missing-terminal signaling requires Lifecycle.RUNNING and explicit run-start semantics from projection.started_at.
Arbitrary evidence_refs must not be treated as proof that a run started.
A run_started event with an empty event_id must still count as start evidence if the existing projection sets started_at from it.
Completed and failed runs remain unchanged.

machine_core.goal: Replace the evidence_refs proxy in missing-run-terminal detection with the existing explicit run-start semantic projection so the signal fires only when start evidence actually exists.
invariants: projection.started_at is the source of truth for observed run_started semantics in this rule.
projection.evidence_refs cardinality/content does not determine whether a run started.
Lifecycle.RUNNING without started_at does not emit missing_run_terminal_evidence.
Lifecycle.RUNNING with started_at emits missing_run_terminal_evidence even if run-start event_id is empty and no usable EvidenceRef exists.
Lifecycle.COMPLETED and Lifecycle.FAILED behavior is unchanged.
No new lifecycle field or parallel lifecycle representation is introduced.

producer.artifact: ExecutionProjection lifecycle/start fields derived from canonical run lifecycle evidence

observable_effect.assertion: Missing-terminal signaling depends on explicit projected run-start evidence (started_at), not on whether unrelated evidence references happen to exist.

proofs.assertion: A RUNNING projection with unrelated evidence_refs but started_at=None does not emit missing_run_terminal_evidence.
A RUNNING projection with started_at set emits missing_run_terminal_evidence even when evidence_refs is empty or the source run_started event id is empty.
Completed and failed projections do not emit the missing-terminal signal.

failure_semantics: RUNNING without explicit start evidence remains insufficient to claim missing terminal evidence.
Started-without-terminal remains incomplete/unknown evidence, not execution failure.
Empty/missing event_id affects provenance quality but must not erase an already-observed run_started semantic fact.

steps.title: Characterize both proxy failures
details: Add a RUNNING projection with unrelated evidence_refs and started_at=None; assert no signal.
Add a RUNNING projection with started_at set and no meaningful evidence_refs; assert the signal is emitted.

steps.title: Replace the proxy condition
details: Change only the missing-terminal rule guard from evidence_refs presence to started_at presence while retaining Lifecycle.RUNNING requirement.
Do not modify how projection.started_at is derived unless tests prove the existing field is not in fact run_started-specific; if that contradiction is found, stop rather than expanding scope.

steps.title: Lock terminal regressions
details: Retain completed, failed, no-start and started-without-terminal behavior tests.

acceptance: RUNNING + started_at=None + unrelated refs does not emit missing_run_terminal_evidence.
RUNNING + started_at set emits missing_run_terminal_evidence regardless of arbitrary refs.
Completed and failed behavior remains unchanged.
No new lifecycle state, EvidenceRef semantics or producer-specific branches are introduced.
ruff, mypy, focused tests and the full pytest suite pass.

must_check: The missing-terminal rule uses projection.started_at rather than evidence_refs as proof of run-start evidence.
Unrelated EvidenceRefs cannot cause a false missing-terminal signal.
An observed run start is not lost solely because its event_id/provenance ref is empty.
Completed and failed lifecycle behavior remains unchanged.
No new lifecycle representation or EvidenceRef redesign is introduced.
Focused tests, full pytest, ruff and mypy pass.
reject_if: The rule still uses evidence_refs presence as the run-start predicate.
runtime_role or another unrelated evidence type can prove run_started.
A new has_started flag or lifecycle subsystem is introduced without evidence that started_at is insufficient.
Validation fails or forbidden files change.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: Explicit run-start semantics for missing-terminal signal without EvidenceRef proxying.
